scope: Combined wardrobe/accessory finishing and small-portrait review. Existing source artwork remains authoritative.
catalogue: Four eyes: Original, Tapered oval, Soft hooded, Rounded bean. No nose; regular smile. Eight canonical colors per hair/top/bottom/headwear, plus Original(review) as contextual authored alias. Four independent frame colors; Reading defaults clear, other glasses dark.
wire: No production IDs, firmware, BLE/LoRa layout, profile bytes or native product code changed. Catalogue keys are artwork review identifiers.
package: Six independent ordinary component GLBs, two ordinary assembled GLBs, two packed assembled Blender scenes, three packed changed-top source scenes and24 matched color/32-bit-Z pairs.
coordinates: Shared world coordinates/transforms retained. Keep hair/headwear, top/bottom, eyes/lashes, frames/lenses and sleeve/torso nodes separately addressable. No per-component centering/resizing or material-only consolidation.
pants_contract: Use pantsBases.clothed or shirtless only for Pants. Their two inactive original leg nodes are not part of the selected glTF scene. Unreachable BIN data is retained; these are compatibility fixtures, not optimized derivatives. Importers must honor active scene graph. Packed Blender fixtures omit excluded leg nodes.
depth: Regenerated from final actual GLBs at120/512(reference span1.65,target1.88) and32/48/64/120(chat span1.35,target1.90). Color/Z pairs share geometry,camera and version. Z does not encode transmitted or refracted layers. Cowboy chat browser framing widens to1.75.
glasses: Frame color is Black in both assembled references. Source lens transmission, alpha, volume and IOR are listed separately in technical262.json. Browser uses a sharp alpha lens approximation. Native transmitted lenses are not certified by the browser images.
blender_transfer: Packed scenes include exact studio lights/world/exposure/color management in assemblies262.json. GLB alone does not carry the studio, view transform, ray-visibility rules or all procedural/normal shader effects. Re-imports can alter reflection/contact shading; retain faithful Blender color references as the comparison authority, do not retune them to match a native renderer.
camera: Face and Body controls retain prior framing; Chat portrait is an added review preset, not a native implementation change.

evidence.second_pass: Reinspect actual exported geometry, hidden-arm contacts, top/bottom details, headgear/glasses matrices, all4 tones and exact small outputs. Three source/export passes; stripe and sleeve-merge trials rejected.
evidence.qualification: Source/export/browser artwork validation. Native rendering, transparent optics and phone performance remain separate.

next_slice: Optimize copies of these two assemblies with ordinary uncompressed GLBs first; preserve semantic nodes, materials, silhouettes and attachment boundaries. Compare262 source against each derivative before accepting it.
Regenerate color and depth together for every changed derivative. Explicitly test transparency and transmission; do not treat alphaMode=OPAQUE as opaque glass.

Compare faithful source -> optimized GLB -> native3D -> lightweight portrait in seeded real-app workloads on iOS and Android. Measure first-use/scroll cost, loading peaks, decoded memory, draw calls and appearance. No whole-catalogue or fixed50–100k acceptance threshold.
approval: New corrections await owner review. This package completes the authorized art/export slice, not production readiness or native/phone qualification.
